subject: stf
title: STF.------MTH.
description: Diagram in MP(II)-8, first of two on book p490, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the State Department's use of creative music must be viewed as a real factor for political persuasion, yet it must also be understood that at no point has this agency ever had any real understanding of what it was broadcasting' — the music exposed people but the apparatus had no comprehension of what it had created. (C)STF (source transfer) is crossed with MTH (methodology): the question is what source-transfer produces when crossed with methodology when the source-transferring institution doesn't comprehend its own apparatus. MTH (the partner) outputs to SCI-DY (scientific dynamics), IST-S (isolated source) → ALGN (alignment) → ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). TRS (transition), ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism), and RT-DY (reality dynamics) cluster in the upper-right. INFO-DY (information dynamics) is a central convergence. PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) feeds the subject from below. RIT-DY (ritual dynamics), WOR-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle, alternate spelling), and RE-ST (restructuralism) constitute the lower production layer. Structural argument: source-transfer crossed with methodology routes through *isolated-source → alignment → alternative-functionalism* — Braxton's diagrammatic claim that even uncomprehending state-broadcast source-transfer can produce alternative functionalism, but only via an isolated-source chain that the broadcasting institution doesn't recognize.
